verdict.rationale: Zoho runs an official, first-party hosted MCP service at zoho.com/mcp that explicitly covers Books: it connects LLMs like Claude or GPT to Zoho's APIs and actions, including generating invoices, tracking payments, logging expenses and creating reports. The Books features page also says users can "Link Zoho Books to your favorite AI agents via MCP," and the MCP page quotes Books customers who connected it to Claude. Missing for 10: documentation of the Books-specific MCP tool catalog and setup/auth steps (the hosted service at mcp.zoho.com is sign-in-gated), independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor-hosted testimonials.
